subcompetencies.name: Surgical Care of Gynecologic Cancer – Open Techniques

level_1: Independently selects appropriate procedures for benign gynecologic conditions
Performs radical cancer- specific procedures
level_2: Proficiently performs benign gynecologic or basic cancer-specific procedures
Independently adapts surgical plan based on unforeseen intra- operative events
level_3: Proposes appropriate cancer-specific procedures
Independently and proficiently performs radical cancer-specific procedures
level_4: Effectively assists during radical cancer-specific procedures
Independently manages complicated or multidisciplinary procedures for patients with multiple comorbidities
level_5: Selects appropriate cancer-specific procedures

level_1: Independently selects appropriate procedures for benign gynecologic conditions

subcompetencies.name: Management of Chemotherapy and Targeted Therapeutics

level_1: Discusses commonly used chemotherapy agents, targeted therapeutics, and common toxicities
level_2: Proposes appropriate options for treatment based on guidelines
level_3: Selects appropriate chemotherapy agents and targeted therapies for treatment based on observed toxicities and guidelines
level_4: Independently adapts chemotherapy agents and targeted therapies based on genetics, tumor testing, and/or toxicities
level_5: Independently manages acute and long-term toxicities and makes appropriate referrals to other members of the interdisciplinary team

level_1: Assesses peri-operative surgical risk and manages routine peri- operative care
level_2: Employs standardized care protocols and recognizes common peri- operative complications
level_3: Manages patients with complex peri-operative needs and common peri- operative complications
level_4: Independently manages patients with complex peri-operative needs and complex peri- operative complications, integrating principles of critical care
level_5: Identifies gaps in peri- operative management and complications to be addressed in quality improvement/research initiatives

level_1: Takes a complete cancer and treatment-related symptom history
level_2: Manages uncomplicated symptoms, integrating standardized symptom assessment tools
level_3: Manages complex symptoms
level_4: Coordinates multidisciplinary management of complex and refractory symptoms
level_5: Applies innovative approaches to symptom management

level_1: Demonstrates knowledge of pelvic anatomy
Applies knowledge of pelvic anatomy, upper abdominal, and retroperitoneal anatomy when reviewing diagnostic studies
level_2: Applies knowledge of normal pelvic anatomy in the surgical setting to reduce surgical complications and morbidity
Applies knowledge of pelvic, retroperitoneal, and upper abdominal anatomy distorted by gynecologic cancer in a complex surgical setting to reduce surgical complications and morbidity
level_3: Demonstrates knowledge of normal retroperitoneal and upper abdominal anatomy
Applies knowledge of pelvic anatomy, upper abdominal, and retroperitoneal anatomy when planning a complex surgical intervention
level_4: Applies knowledge of pelvic anatomy distorted by gynecologic cancer in a complex surgical setting to reduce surgical complications and morbidity
Applies knowledge of pelvic and abdominal anatomy to complex surgical cases and identifies areas for surgical innovation and quality improvement
level_5: Applies knowledge of pelvic, retroperitoneal, and upper abdominal anatomy distorted by gynecologic cancer in a straightforward surgical setting to reduce surgical complications and morbidity

subcompetencies.name: Medical Diseases in Gynecologic Cancer – Organ System Disorders

level_1: Demonstrates knowledge of common medical conditions that can affect patient outcomes
level_2: Applies knowledge of common medical co- morbidities to optimize patient outcomes
level_3: Demonstrates knowledge of complex organ system disorders, metabolic derangements, and coagulopathies
level_4: Applies knowledge of complex organ system disorders to optimize patient outcomes
level_5: Applies an evidence-based approach to innovative management of the gynecologic cancer patient with complex medical conditions

level_1: Demonstrates knowledge of basic genetics and common hereditary cancer syndromes in gynecologic cancer
Demonstrates knowledge of targeted therapeutic principles and cancer immunotherapy
level_2: Demonstrates knowledge of basic carcinogenesis and gynecologic cancer prevention strategies
Applies knowledge of hereditary cancer syndromes to optimize patient outcomes
level_3: Applies knowledge of basic cancer genetics to patient counseling
Applies knowledge of cancer biology and immunology to develop treatment plans for patients with gynecologic cancers
level_4: Demonstrates knowledge of basic cancer biology and immunology
Investigates and applies evidence-based principles of genetics to optimize patient outcomes
level_5: Demonstrates knowledge of less common hereditary cancer syndromes and genetic alterations
Investigates and applies evidence-based principles of cancer biology and/or immunology to optimize patient outcomes

subcompetencies.name: Radiation Therapy – Radiation Biology and Physics

level_1: Discusses common therapeutic radiation techniques
Demonstrates knowledge of management strategies for radiation complications
level_2: Demonstrates knowledge of common complications of radiation therapy
Applies comprehensive knowledge of radiation therapy to optimize patient outcomes
level_3: Demonstrates knowledge of the indications for adjuvant and primary therapy
Applies knowledge of management strategies for complex radiation complications
level_4: Demonstrates knowledge of initial evaluation of patients with radiation toxicities
Investigates principles of innovative radiation therapy in collaboration with a radiation oncologist
level_5: Demonstrates knowledge of basic radiation biology
Investigates novel management strategies for radiation complications

level_1: Demonstrates knowledge of commonly used systemic therapies
level_2: Discusses therapeutic options, mechanisms of action, and common toxicities of common systemic therapies based on literature
level_3: Demonstrates comprehensive knowledge of systemic therapy options based on literature
level_4: Applies knowledge of systemic therapeutic agents to individualize management
level_5: Explores emerging therapies and extrapolates to rare or complex clinical scenarios

level_1: Demonstrates knowledge of basic diagnostic techniques to evaluate patients with gynecologic neoplasms

Synthesizes results of pathologic, genomic, and molecular studies to create effective treatment plans
level_4: Demonstrates knowledge of pathologic studies used to identify and subcategorize malignant and premalignant gynecologic pathology
Applies innovative evidence-based diagnostic techniques to develop treatment plans for patients with gynecologic cancers
level_5: Discusses diagnostic techniques to comprehensively evaluate patients with gynecologic cancer

level_1: Describes the basics of clinical study design and levels of evidence
level_2: Demonstrates knowledge of study design, including statistical methods
level_3: Critically interprets the results of a clinical study, including statistical limitations
level_4: Applies knowledge of clinical study design, research infrastructure, and analytical statistics and integrates these into clinical practice
level_5: Proposes and designs clinical investigation

level_1: Identifies general eligibility for hospice care
level_2: Addresses basic patient/family questions about hospice and death from cancer
level_3: Addresses complex patient/family questions about hospice, discontinuation of disease-directed therapy, and death from cancer
level_4: Individualizes advice to patients/patient families about timing of hospice enrollment and appropriately sets patient/family expectations for last days to weeks of life
level_5: Coordinates multidisciplinary response to complex circumstances, such as family conflict and futile care near the end of life

level_1: Demonstrates knowledge of common patient safety events

level_3: Demonstrates knowledge of basic quality improvement methodologies and metrics

Creates, implements, and assesses quality improvement initiatives at the institutional or community level

level_1: Demonstrates knowledge of care coordination

level_2: Identifies key elements for safe and effective transitions of care and hand-offs

level_1: Demonstrates knowledge of population and community health needs
level_2: Identifies specific population and community health needs for the local population
level_3: Uses local resources effectively to meet the needs of a patient population and community
level_4: Participates in changing and adapting practice to provide for the needs of specific populations

subcompetencies.name: Physician Role in Health Care Systems

level_1: Identifies key components of the complex health care system
level_2: Describes how components of a complex health care system are inter-related, and how this impacts patient care
level_3: Discusses how individual practice affects the broader system
level_4: Manages various components of the complex health care system to provide efficient and effective patient care
level_5: Advocates for or leads systems change that enhances high value, efficient and effective patient care

level_1: Demonstrates how to access and use available evidence and incorporate patient preferences and values to the care of a routine patient
level_2: Articulates clinical questions and elicits patient preferences and values to guide evidence- based care, with guidance from other health care team members

subcompetencies.name: Reflective Practice and Commitment to Personal Growth

level_1: Identifies gap(s) between expectations and actual performance
Integrates practice data and feedback, with humility, to implement a learning plan
level_2: Establishes goals for personal and professional development
Continuously reflects on remaining gap(s) and institutes behavioral adjustments to narrow them
level_3: Analyzes and reflects on the factors that contribute to gap(s) between expectations and actual performance
Uses performance data to measure the effectiveness of the learning plan and adapts it when necessary
level_4: Identifies opportunities for performance improvement; designs a learning plan
Coaches others on reflective practice
level_5: Institutes behavioral change(s) to narrow the gap(s) between expectations and actual performance
Coaches others in the design and implementation of learning plans

level_1: Identifies areas worthy of scholarly investigation
level_2: Designs a hypothesis- driven or hypothesis- generating scholarly thesis, under the direction of a research mentor
level_3: Presents products of scholarly activity at local, regional, or national meetings, and/or submits an abstract to regional, state, or national meetings
level_4: Completes and defends a comprehensive written scholarly thesis that demonstrates advanced research methodology, design, and statistical analysis

level_1: Identifies and describes potential triggers for professionalism lapses and how to appropriately report them

level_4: Analyzes straightforward situations using ethical principles
Coaches others when their behavior fails to meet professional expectations
level_5: Demonstrates professional behavior in complex or stressful situations

level_1: Responds promptly to requests to complete tasks; takes ownership for completion of tasks and responsibilities

level_3: Performs tasks and responsibilities in a timely manner with appropriate attention to detail in complex or stressful situations

level_1: Recognizes status of personal and professional well-being, with assistance

level_1: Elicits pre-existing preferences related to code status, advance care planning, and medical power of attorney
